name: process_step_handler_integration
label: Process Component Reference Integration Table
description: The table for integrating process components with integration can be used for querying, filtering, and reporting on process-related data.

fields.name: handler
fields.description: Node component type, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: integration_uuid
fields.description: Integration with UUID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the handler, integration_uuid fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_integration_uuid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the integration_uuid field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
